title: Bandit Justice
description: Three wagons haven't made the north road this month, and the last driver's mule came back to Elder Moor alone. The empire pays for eyes on a problem before it pays for swords - I need a count on that camp before I requisition more men than this town can spare. Every week they sit up there is a week the road stays closed.

objectives.description: Get eyes on the bandit camp without starting a fight you can't win alone

notes: Threat: a bandit camp on the north road has killed at least one driver and stopped wagons reaching Elder Moor. Giver motive: the guard captain can't requisition outside help without a scouted headcount - the town has no men to spare on a guess. Consequence of refusal: the road stays closed and the raids escalate; not wired to data, recorded here.
